messages.wizard.modeQrDescription: Ƙirƙiri lambar QR da za a iya dubawa don hanyar haɗi, menu, katin tuntuɓa, takarda ko biyan kuɗi.
messages.wizard.pillarActionsDescription: Ba baƙi damar aika buƙata, sannan ka duba amsoshin a wurin aikinka.
messages.wizard.pillarBasicDescription: Zaɓuɓɓuka masu sauƙi don amfanin yau da kullum: hanyoyin haɗi, katunan tuntuɓa, menu, jagorori da fayiloli.
messages.wizard.pillarProfilesDescription: Ƙirƙiri bayanin martaba da za a iya rabawa na mutum, kasuwanci, hukuma ko ƙungiya.
messages.wizard.pillarSharedDescription: Buga taƙaitattun jagorori da ayyuka na jama'a da baƙi da yawa za su iya amfani da su.
messages.wizard.purposeDescription: Zaɓi manufar da ta fi dacewa da abin da baƙi za su fuskanta.
messages.wizard.purposeLandingSummary: Ƙirƙiri shafi mai sassauƙa da babban hoto, labari da kiran ɗaukar mataki.
messages.wizard.purposeMenuSummary: Jera rukuni da farashin ETB, tare da zaɓin bayanan Telebirr.
messages.wizard.purposePaymentsSummary: Nuna daga QR da aka buga zuwa URL na biyan kuɗi da aka ɗauki nauyinsa.
messages.wizard.purposePdfSummary: Riƙe gajeren lamba a bugawa yayin da ake iya sauya takardar da aka ɗauki nauyinta.
messages.wizard.purposeTourismSummary: Ba da damar wurin ya yi magana da harsuna da yawa ta sauti da GPS.
messages.wizard.purposeVcardSummary: Raba katin tuntuɓa da mutane za su iya ajiyewa da taɓawa ɗaya.
messages.wizard.reviewDescription: Lambar da aka buga za ta riƙe wannan gajeren adireshi, yayin da za ka iya sabunta abin da ke bayansa daga baya.
messages.wizard.shortCodeReady: Gajeren lambarka ta shirya. Sauke hoton QR ko buɗe samfurin abin da baƙi za su gani.
messages.wizard.title: Ƙirƙiri ƙwarewar QR
messages.wizard.updatesAsYouType: Yana sabuntawa yayin da kake rubutu
messages.templates.qrSafetyNote: Tabbatar da bambanci mai ƙarfi tsakanin launi mai duhu da mai haske, kuma ka bar yankin da ke kewaye da lambar a sarari domin a iya tantance ta cikin sauƙi.
messages.templates.storageUsage: An yi amfani da: {used} MB daga cikin {limit} MB na ma’ajiyar bayanai
messages.templates.storageLimitReached: An kai iyakar ma’ajiyar bayanai. Haɓaka tsarin biyan kuɗinka don ƙara wasu fayiloli.
